about_the_game:
BugLab isn't just another simulation game — it's a deep laboratory management experience where tiny creatures power big ambitions.

What starts with a single terrarium evolves into a growing production empire. Raise, feed, sell, automate, and process various insect species, each with unique needs and economic value. As you manage the life cycles within your terrariums, you'll need to balance resources and make strategic decisions as your systems expand.

Production goes far beyond insects. Cultivate tomatoes, wheat, and cabbage in farm plots, produce honey through beekeeping systems, and process gathered raw materials into feed using specialized machines. The food chain you build becomes the backbone of your entire ecosystem.

The game is designed with rich mechanics such as automated feeding, feed production, resource conversion, inventory systems, upgradable hives and terrariums, quests, timed machines, and even interactions with the world outside your lab.

🧪 Unlock new systems over time as the game continues to grow.
🐛 Each insect species introduces unique challenges and benefits.
🌱 Build, manage, and optimize your own production loop.
🔄 Regular content updates bring new species, structures, and mechanics to discover.

BugLab is the playable embodiment of “building a grand system from tiny lifeforms.” Start your own insect-based production journey and take the first step into a one-of-a-kind experience!

name: BugLab Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

short_description: Manage terrariums, breed insects, produce resources, and expand your lab into a thriving ecosystem. BugLab blends automation, strategy, and simulation with ever-growing systems.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Azerbaijani
